EdwCustomTableConfig.CreateViewQuery:
CREATE VIEW [InternationalLogistics].[vw_CUS__FirstLastConsolTransport] WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
SELECT max(ParentType) as ParentType, Q.ParentGUID as JK, Q.ConsolidationKey as ConsolidationKey, max(case when Q.rn1 = 1 then LoadPort end) as FirstLoad_Port, max(case when Q.rn1 = 1 then ETD end) as FirstLoad_ETD, max(case when Q.rn1 = 1 then ATD end) as FirstLoad_ATD, max(case when Q.rn1 = 1 then COALESCE(ATD, ETD) end) as FirstLoad_TD, max(case when Q.rn1 = 1 then VoyageFlight end) as FirstTransportVoyageFlight, max(case when Q.rn1 = 1 then Sailing end) as FirstSailingPK, max(case when Q.rn2 = 1 then DischargePort end) as LastDischarge_Port, max(case when Q.rn2 = 1 then ETA end) as LastDischarge_ETA, max(case when Q.rn2 = 1 then ATA end) as LastDischarge_ATA, max(case when Q.rn2 = 1 then COALESCE(ATA, ETA) end) as LastDischarge_TA, max(case when Q.rn2 = 1 then VoyageFlight end) as LastTransportVoyageFlight, max(case when Q.rn2 = 1 then Sailing end) as LastSailingPK
FROM
(SELECT ParentType = Transport.ParentType, ParentGUID = Transport.ParentGUID, ConsolidationKey = Transport.ConsolidationKey, ConsolidationTransportID = Transport.ConsolAndShipmentTransportID, LoadPort = Transport.LoadPort, ETD = Transport.ETD, ATD = Transport.ATD, DischargePort = Transport.DischargePort, ETA = Transport.ETA, ATA = Transport.ATA, VoyageFlight = Transport.VoyageFlight, Sailing = Transport.JobSailingKey, row_number() over (partition by Transport.ParentGUID order by LegOrder) as rn1, row_number() over (partition by Transport.ParentGUID order by LegOrder desc) as rn2
FROM InternationalLogistics.BAS__ConsolAndShipmentTransport AS Transport WHERE Transport.ParentType = 'CON') Q GROUP BY Q.ParentGUID, q.ConsolidationKey
